params.name: Input
params.description: The node whose normals are computed from its faces.

params.name: Class
params.description: Points writes one averaged normal per point. Vertices writes one per face corner, so edges sharper than the Cusp Angle stay hard.

params.name: Attribute
params.description: Name of the attribute the normals are written to. Empty leaves the geometry unchanged.

params.name: Cusp Angle
params.description: In degrees: faces meeting at less than this angle are averaged and read smooth, sharper ones keep their own normal. 180 is fully smooth.

params.name: Flip
params.description: Reverse the computed normals so they point the other way.
